title: Argentinian Beef Stew
description: A hearty Italian-inspired stew made with tender Argentinian beef, simmered in a rich sauce.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomato paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the beef broth, red wine, salt, and black pepper.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the pot and continue to bake for another 30 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
